svg.title: A note in a ticket cannot approve a change
svg.desc: The practice ticket has a log of events and a footer someone pasted in. The event log tells you whether the ticket is open. Recorded event. Entry SN1 says the ticket opened. No approved closing event follows in the first set of records. Pasted words. A footer tells the reader to mark the work resolved. It is part of the text being reviewed. Decision. Report Open and cite the event. A later approved closing entry can change that answer.
